input: Six signed IQ16 pairs; logical order supplied by board adapter
power: Unsigned I squared plus Q squared; 32 bits, maximum 2147483648
energy: Unsigned 46-bit sum over all accepted samples, including invalid samples with sticky bad flag; never use bad result as qualified data
start: Accepted only when ready and sample_enable=0 and finish=0; no same-edge result retirement/replacement; otherwise rejected pulse
sampling: sample_enable asserts membership in the caller-selected window; idle cycles outside membership do not imply a missing sample
quality: Caller supplies sample_good and time-aligned late_bad; bad flags sticky during active window; finish must wait for final late flags
finish: May coincide with final sample; publishes immutable result until result_ready; empty result marks every channel bad
overflow: Extra samples after 16384 do not wrap or change accumulated energy; mark overflow and all channels bad
reset: Cancels active window and pending result
